hooks.command: bash -lc 'json=$(cat); if command -v mysecond >/dev/null 2>&1 && [ "$(mysecond --version </dev/null 2>/dev/null)" = "1.12.0" ]; then printf "%s" "$json" | mysecond emit-event --silent 2>/dev/null && exit 0; fi; printf "%s" "$json" | npx -y @mysecond/cli@1.12.0 emit-event --silent 2>/dev/null || true  # mysecond-companion-usage-hook'
